embeds.title: The Venture Bros: Grand Galactic Inquisitor

content: I have never felt so much dissapointed about this update ngl..

So... time for some constructive criticism after adjustment: 

**The rise of Gimmick teams: **
Strategies revolving around Max-hp damage (lotan+),  low-max hp (gMurphy, Salvador), enemy scaling (gLotan), stall (casiah, agrippa, Kath) are quickly becomming the norm for Madness clears. Each of these might seem like a cleaver use of mechanics (they are), but when they are the only strategies avaiable for 99% of the playerbase you have a problem.

**ECOG**
ECOG now being part of D-Zone has a couple of important negatives, 1) Someone that wants to just maximize their reward can no longer do their waves in one sitting, instead they might need to space out their waves to do one roughly every 3 days which causes unnecessary friction. I guess it's on you if you think the additional psycological hook designed to make people spend money for that next ECOG use to clear is worth it. 

**Turn rewind**
Turn rewind simply creates unfun and tedious play patterns, I assume the original design was to be able to fix wrong plays, but it is now a tool to guarantee your DR or Discover effects while greatly increasing play time and potential burnout. It should probably just be removed and change into some other reward, but otherwise decouple these random effects from others so they are not as easily manipulated.

**Final thoughs and suggestions: **
Remove Madness or scale madness to current or slightly above nightmare. Beating Nightmare twice as max difficult would be just as much of a statement as beating Madness now, but you get rid of the excessive turn numbers in current Madness clears. Whales can feel powerful again, and non-whales have something actually attainable to work towards. The game and characters simple aren't designed to be able to deal 10m+ damage.
